body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: b0a046a9e13bdce9ddbf836e138d54ebe65355ad -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks for moving this over from #429. Reviewed at head b0a046a9, trial-merged with current `upstream/main` (5fd2b93a).

**What looks good**
- The trial merge is clean. There are no conflicts and no semantic clash with the per-setup mounts (#471), because the code only uses `setup_align::alignment`/`compose`/`inverse` and `setup::active`. Those functions are unchanged on main.
- The change is small, with no new dependencies and no `build.rs`, scripts or `.github` edits. The only shader edit is one `case 4` arm in `fs_stock`.
- Prime Directive: there is no `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic` on the new paths. A bad sheet index is skipped, an empty body or sheet is refused by name, and a failed measurement is logged once and draws nothing.
- The preview is view-only state that follows the open page and is never undoable, which fits the command law. No components were added, and the layering is ui -> app.
- Measurement is keyed by (setup, active setup, `doc_version`), so the program sim does not run per frame. The page's box and volume reuse that measurement.
- New modules carry provenance lines. All files are well under 400 lines. The decision file is in `docs/decisions/`. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #406`, and `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched.
- The contributor's hands-on GUI check passed. I did not run the GUI.

**Local results (merged with main, debug, macOS)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --no-run` | builds |
| app `setup_stock_view` | 2 passed |
| app `setup_stock_source` (nearby suite) | 6 passed |
| ui `--lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 378 passed, 1 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

The ui lib failure is `egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds`. It fails only because this machine has no GPU adapter, which the PR body also lists as a known headless red:
```
egui headless run failed: No suitable graphics adapter found; ... metal had no fallback adapters ...
```
The new `incoming_view_tests` pass.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- The z-fighting speckle on the teal top face, where it is coplanar with the setup's own Stock box, is already noted in the thread. A depth bias on the overlay would fix it later. It would also be worth opening an issue for it.
- The teal overlay hides while the traced whole-program stock view is active. This is documented as a known limit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
